workflow: When a phase is unusually well-specified (root cause known, file/line targets identified, scoping settled), skipping discuss-phase and going straight to plan-phase is appropriate.
The gsd:plan-phase skill accepts --skip-research to bypass research when RESEARCH.md already exists; conversely, research-only mode (--research-phase N) is cheapest for correction loops.
Git commit signing can cause apparent hangs; verifying via git log immediately after is a reliable way to confirm the commit landed without waiting on sign feedback.
